status: frozen before expanded parity and public-score evaluation
claim: Exact pinned scalar VUS in O(n log(Q+1) + (L+1) Q) time; novelty remains subject to prior art

public_data.primary_score_archive: doi:10.48804/MCVI4N, KU Leuven RDR, V1, CC-BY-4.0
public_data.selection: Use all common valid TSB-AD-U evaluation series in three model families: Chronos, TimesFM, Time-MoE. In each family choose lexicographically first archive among the smallest context length; if inaccessible, record failure, no score-based replacement. Freeze exact file IDs and names in data_manifest.json before evaluation.
baselines: official 250-threshold on first 12 valid names only
public_data.parity: Compare sparse full-threshold against both dense implementations on every selected score. Compare official full-threshold on fixed 256-point first-anomaly crops. Compare independently implemented sampled250 against official250 on those crops and timing subset.
public_data.rank_reversal: All unordered model pairs per series and width; report strict sign reversal with absolute difference > 1e-10 in both exact and sampled results. Report ties separately. Report dataset-family clustered counts and top-model changes. No model performance claims.

reporting: Include negative results, all exclusions, dense-support slowdowns, timings excluding download and warm-up, and hardware/software. Do not call sampled and exact computations identical. No SOTA or publication claim without external evidence.
